symbol.description: Ticker symbol — equity (`AAPL`), ETF (`SPY`), or index (`^DJI`).

modules.description: Which Yahoo quoteSummary modules to fetch. Default is a useful subset for chat — summaryDetail (price metadata), assetProfile (sector/industry/business summary), price (display name), defaultKeyStatistics (beta, share counts). Add more sparingly — each module enlarges the response.
